response.sql:
WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: A processing run whose site code matches a site is found via an inner join to sites; runs with no matching site are excluded.

The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per run using real division (cast to avoid integer division), and runs with zero CPU usage (division by zero) are treated as missing and ignored via NULLIF. Runs with null GPU or CPU yield null ratios and are ignored by AVG.
The memory filter is applied before per-site averaging, so null memusagegb rows are excluded.
